fd_contract.transport: Fixed ScreenCast/OpenPipeWireRemote and RemoteDesktop/ConnectToEIS whitelist only. Existing exact pending serial, unique sender, h/body index0, one received FD, noninheritable Unix stream verification, no-auto-start and finally cleanup retained.

fd_contract.close: Pending original connect or active wire operation returns false and keeps native Session/subscriptions/FD. Borrowing socket must detach successfully before original FD is released; failure keeps the same owner for close retry. Actual core failure/cancellation never revives old connection.

ei_contract.handshake: Server handshake_version must be first and nonzero; negotiate v1, explicitly sender2, fixed product name, only ei_connection/ei_callback/ei_pingpong v1, then finish. Bounded interface-name parsing; duplicate/invalid announcements refused. Connection new_id must be in increasing server namespace and actual object version1; initial serial is arbitrary including max uint32.
ei_contract.sync: Increasing nonreused client callback IDs, exact callback done0, optional monotonically allocated server ping v1 and fixed pong0. No seat/device/input interface announced or request emitted. Peer explanation not returned.

ei_contract.scope: Core connection readiness only. It does not prove device availability, input release, physical activity pause, target association, frame mapping, app outcome or business authorization.
